notes: New page: BEVCO Esteemed Lifting. Search an item, the category, size and landing price come from your Landing Cost File by themselves, type the bottles and press Enter — the line is saved and the next one opens at once. Every line stays editable (item, category, size, landing price, qty), the amount is qty x landing price, and the GRAND TOTAL ESTEEMED sits at the foot. Search your lines, print or send it to Excel. It is an order sheet only: no stock and no rate anywhere else changes.
